_meta.label: English
_meta.note: Resident outcome messages. Machine-drafted, pending city language review. Placeholders: {date}, {owner}.

outcome.FIXED: Fixed on {date}. Thanks for reporting it.
outcome.MADE_SAFE: We made it safe for now. The full repair is scheduled for {date}.
outcome.SCHEDULED: This is scheduled for {date}. We will update you when the work is done.
outcome.DEFERRED_CAPITAL: This needs a larger project. Our target is {date}.
outcome.NOT_OURS: We sent this to {owner}, who owns this location.
outcome.NOT_FOUND: Our crew could not find the problem. Can you send a photo or more detail?
outcome.PRIVATE_PROPERTY: This is on private property, so the city cannot do the repair. The note explains who to contact.
outcome.DUPLICATE: Someone already reported this. We merged your report with theirs and are tracking it.
outcome.NEEDS_INFO: The crew needs more information before they can start: {note}
